start.description: Startup script to run when creating a new workspace (worktree)

status.description: Current status of the task: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

priority.description: Priority level of the task: high, medium, low

files_changed.description: Every file touched in this goal. A goal that produced zero file changes is invalid — do not call this tool without deliverables.

summary.description: What changed in this file and why. One or two sentences, concrete — not 'updated foo'.

checks_run.description: Commands executed to verify the goal (build / test / lint / verify). Empty array is allowed only for goals whose acceptance is entirely rubric/semantic.

output_excerpt.description: Last relevant lines of stdout/stderr (≤ 2000 chars). Omit when trivially green.

implementation_approach.description: The actual implementation plan: what scheme you used, core structure, key APIs, and data flow. Must describe the approach concretely so an evaluator can cross-check the diff against it.

design_decisions.description: Key decisions and why. Each entry names the alternatives considered and the reason the chosen one won. Empty array means the goal required no non-trivial decision.

choice.description: The decision made, stated as a concrete claim.

alternatives.description: Alternatives that were considered and rejected. Empty array if none were weighed.

reason.description: Why this choice won over the alternatives. Must be a real reason, not a restatement of the choice.

blockers.description: Hard blockers hit during execution. Empty when none. A filled array signals the goal did not fully complete.

publicUrl.description: Public base URL used for externally visible attachment links

mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

appToken.description: Slack app token for Socket Mode

enabled.description: Enable Feishu or Lark channel integration

verificationToken.description: Optional Feishu or Lark webhook verification token

webhookHost.description: Optional Feishu or Lark webhook host

webhookPort.description: Optional Feishu or Lark webhook port

webhookPath.description: Optional Feishu or Lark webhook path

numberId.description: WhatsApp Cloud API phone number ID

serviceAccount.description: Google Chat service account JSON or path

secret.description: Optional LINE channel secret for webhook verification

appId.description: QQ Bot app ID from q.qq.com

appSecret.description: QQ Bot app secret used for access token and webhook signatures

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox flag, set to 1 or true to use sandbox.api.sgroup.qq.com

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

tools.description: Tool adapter: whitelist (include) or blacklist (exclude) of tool IDs visible to this agent

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.

anyOf.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.
Disable timeout for this provider entirely.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

share.description: Control sharing behavior:'manual' allows manual sharing via commands, 'auto' enables automatic sharing, 'disabled' disables all sharing

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'build' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

prompt.description: System-scope prompt overrides keyed by prompt identifier (e.g. core_header)

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

tool_permissions.description: Default tool permission actions for new tasks. When not set, defaults to 'ask'. Set a tool to 'allow' to skip confirmation, or 'deny' to block it entirely.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

assistant.description: Assistant agent configuration — controls requirements, planner, evaluator, and delivery agent behavior

requirements.description: Requirements agent configuration — analyzes input, extracts requirements, decomposes into goal contracts

max_steps.description: Maximum agentic steps for requirements agent

skills.description: Additional skill paths for requirements agent

architect.description: Architect agent configuration — cross-goal coordination, interface contracts. Model is configured via agent.architect.model.

max_steps.description: Maximum agentic steps for architect agent

skills.description: Additional skill paths for architect agent

max_steps.description: Maximum agentic steps for planner agent

skills.description: Additional skill paths for planner agent

skills.description: Additional skill paths for delivery agent

delivery_visual.description: P0-B delivery visual numeric hard-gate thresholds.

phash_hamming_max.description: P0-B hard gate: pHash Hamming distance upper bound (structure)

ssim_min.description: P0-B hard gate: mean SSIM lower bound (texture/detail)

chart_region_density_min_ratio.description: P0-B hard gate: chart-region non-white density ratio lower bound (anti empty-skeleton)

unique_color_ratio_min.description: P0-B hard gate: unique-color ratio lower bound (anti monochrome placeholder)

text_hit_ratio_min.description: P0-B hard gate: reference_strings hit ratio lower bound (anti placeholder copy)

score_weights.description: Composite score weights; four values must sum to 1 (runtime-enforced)

design_analyst.description: Design analyst agent configuration — analyzes visual references (images, URLs). Model is configured via agent."design-analyst".model.

max_steps.description: Maximum agentic steps for design analyst agent

skills.description: Additional skill paths for design analyst agent

max_steps.description: Maximum agentic steps for intent-analysis agent

skills.description: Additional skill paths for intent-analysis agent

activity.description: Chunk-driven inactivity gates. Single source of truth for streaming layers (session LLM, executor events, task queue).

session_llm_idle_ms.description: Max idle (no stream chunk) window for session LLM streams, ms

executor_events_idle_ms.description: Max idle window for the executor event queue, ms

task_queue_run_timeout_ms.description: Total wall-clock cap for a single queued task run, ms

default_workflow.description: Default workflow for new tasks: 'direct' (build → deliver iter), 'pipeline' (design_analysis → requirements → architect → per-goal build → deliver iter), or custom ID

workflows.description: Custom workflow definitions. Override built-in workflows by matching ID.

tool.description: Orchestrator tool name this step maps to

hint.description: Brief guidance injected into system prompt

scope.description: task = once per task, goal = once per goal

skippable.description: Whether Orchestrator can skip this step

goalLoopStepIDs.description: Step IDs forming the per-goal loop (for UI grouping)

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

auto_permission.description: Auto-approve PermissionNext requests. Independent fine-grained switch — replaces the old `unattended` umbrella flag. Set to false if you want to be prompted for each tool-use permission.

auto_question.description: Auto-reject unanswered question interactions after the stale timeout. Independent fine-grained switch. When false, questions wait indefinitely for a user reply.

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

auto_inject.description: Auto-inject relevant memories into system prompt

token_budget.description: Max tokens for auto-injected memory context

startCommand.description: Additional startup script to run after the project's start command
